title: Dune: A Zeroth-Order Optimizer with Time-Conditioned Historical Error Regression for VLA Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to handle distribution shifts during deployment without source-domain retraining. However, backpropagation-based adaptation incurs heavy memory overhead on resource-constrained robots, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) methods suffer from high estimation variance under limited perturbation budgets. We observe that while ZO estimation enables low-memory adaptation with rapid initial gains, it often stalls or degrades over long-horizon updates due to noisy gradient estimates. To address these limitations, we propose Dune, a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon adaptation by coupling online historical error prediction with current perturbation observations. Specifically, Dune learns a lightweight, time-conditioned error predictor from past optimization dynamics and fuses its predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates, achieving effective variance reduction with

translated_title: Dune：一种具有时间条件历史误差回归的零阶优化器，用于VLA测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 测试时自适应（TTA）使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在部署过程中应对分布偏移，而无需在源域上重新训练。然而，基于反向传播的自适应方法在资源受限的机器人上会带来沉重的内存开销，而零阶（ZO）方法在有限的扰动预算下存在较高的估计方差。我们观察到，尽管零阶估计能够以低内存开销实现自适应并获得快速的初始收益，但由于梯度估计含有噪声，其在长时程更新中往往会停滞甚至退化。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了Dune，这是一种零阶优化器，通过将在线历史误差预测与当前扰动观测相耦合来稳定长时程自适应。具体而言，Dune从过去的优化动态中学习一个轻量级的、时间条件化的误差预测器，并将其预测与瞬时零阶估计相融合，从而实现了有效的方差降低（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: Dune是一种零阶优化器，它通过将时间条件化的历史误差预测与瞬时零阶估计相融合来降低估计方差，从而在资源受限的机器人上稳定VLA模型的长时程测试时自适应。
en_tdlr: Dune is a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon test-time adaptation for VLA models by fusing time-conditioned historical error predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates to achieve effective variance reduction.
